content:
nora: Starting deploy for payments-api 1.9.0 in the 01:00 UTC change window. Feature flag `payments-v2-route` will be drip-enabled. please ack and watch.

tom: ack. what's the drip plan?

nora: Plan: EU canary 3% for 8m, then 15% for 12m, 40% for 20m. After EU steady -> NA 10%/25%/50% then APAC full. fast-disable threshold set.

rachel: fast-disable triggers: errors +0.4% for 4m OR transaction-fail-rate +0.2% absolute for 3m. Also if payment authorizations time out >150ms p95 for 5m.

infra-monitor: alerting hooks enabled. Pager if errors >0.6% sustained 3m. Logs stream -> https://infra.redwood/streams/payments/canary

nora: We'll pin enterprise customers to v1 for 45m: `pin:enterprise=true -> v1`. avoids customer noise.

deploybot: Deploy queued by nora. Run: pay-deploy-1779990000. Command: `/deploy payments-api --image=redwood/payments:1.9.0 --ff=payments-v2-route:3% --pin=enterprise:true`

tom: Quick runbook reminder: to fast-disable use `ffctl disable payments-v2-route` and then `pinctl rollback payments-api --to=1.8.7`.

rachel: adding smoke check: run `./tools/smoke_payments.sh region eu` after each step. I'll paste results.

deploybot: Deploy started. Step 1: image push -> success. Step 2: enable ff 3% in EU -> success.

infra-monitor: EU 3% ok. small latency wobble but within margin.

rachel: smoke results: auth flow 10/10, charge flow 9/10 (one retry). keeping watch.

tom: leave rollout guard in place: `rate-limit: 200rps` on new route until 15%.

nora: noted. release-manager please add to release notes: "payments: improved batching and latency; opt-in via ff payments-v2-route. enterprise pinned to v1 for initial soak."

release-manager: added to PR #4891 with rollout timeline + pin info.

deploybot: Advance: EU -> 15% complete. Smoke checks triggered.

rachel: EU 15% smoke: all green. moving to 40% after 12m window.

infra-monitor: seeing a small uptick in downstream db retries at T+18m (still below alert). watching.

tom: if db retries trend up, we should stop at 40% and run partial-rollforward tests, not jump regions.

nora: agreed. decision criteria: if db retries >100/min sustained 5m -> pause and diag.

deploybot: EU 40% -> success. Starting NA slice at 10%.

infra-monitor: NA 10% shows error-rate bump 0.45% at T+6m -> exceeds pre-set fast-disable.

rachel: triggering fast-disable now.

deploybot: Executing emergency disable command: `ffctl disable payments-v2-route` -> success.

tom: pinning back to stable: `pinctl set payments-api --version=1.8.7 --reason="fast-disable after NA error spike"` -> success.

infra-monitor: Alerts sent to oncall and channel. opening incident room #inc-1779990000-payments.

nora: good call. capture logs and traces: `traces.get --run=pay-deploy-1779990000 --span=route_switch` and attach to incident.

rachel: running post-disable smoke: auth 10/10, charge 10/10. system stable.

tom: annotate the rollout with timestamps and the ff disable -> we need to pretend the NA slice didn't progress. mark rollout as aborted for NA.

release-manager: Updated changelog: rollout started EU, aborted NA due to error spike; enterprise remained pinned to v1. Logged run ID pay-deploy-1779990000.

nora: Postmortem checklist: collect canary traces, correlate db retry metrics, and split routing telemetry to see model route fallbacks. We'll reconvene tomorrow.

deploybot: Run closed (pay-deploy-1779990000) status: partial-rollout -> disabled.

rachel: saved smoke outputs and attached to PR. Will run a follow-up dry-run in staging with increased observability.

nora: thanks team. we'll reattempt after fixes. :pray:
